title: Windows XP Error
blurb: Few chimes have ruined more afternoons. The Windows XP error ding is the sound of something going wrong in 2003, permanently installed in the memory of everyone who grew up with a family computer. Microsoft hired Bill Brown to compose the XP sound set, aiming for warmth rather than alarm, so the error tone came out oddly gentle for a message that usually meant the homework was gone. Today it is pure nostalgic comedy. Play it when someone makes a mistake and watch an entire generation flinch in unison.
origin: The critical-error chime from Microsoft Windows XP (2001).
